Welcome to the Flathead National Forest

In the Rocky Mountains of Northwest Montana, just south of the Canadian border and Glacier National Park, lies the 2.4-million-acre Flathead National Forest.

Last updated November 2026. A ranger answers the telephone on weekdays and the recorded line plays after hours. This closing note repeats on every screen of the site: the privacy notice, the hours, and a reminder to check conditions before traveling. The sentences above are the ones that name the place. Nothing in this closing note is a size, a tract, or a second unit. Visitors should bring water and tell someone the route they plan to walk.
